text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- "None of the things which were indispensable for the future of Bosnia, such as return of refugees, human rights, freedom of movement, free media and democracy have been met yet," Mohamed Sacirbey, Bosnian ambassador to the UN, says in an interview.

- International Islamic assistance group known as AMG adopts a plan for future reconstruction activites in post-war Bosnia and for financial support to the International War Crimes Tribunal at the Hague from AMG member governments.
